name: v1.5.0
body:
# V1.5.0 Release notes

## What's new
The main new addition is adding throttle detect for supported AMD CPUs. This is not as advanced as the Intel version, but if a CPU is being throttled below it's base clock due to power or temperature limitations, this will be indicated by a change in color of the graph and of the statistic line
Also bug fixes and stability improvements thaks to new contributors. 


## What's Changed
* Unsafe handling of psutil.cpu_count() by @tang-vu in https://github.com/amanusk/s-tui/pull/278
* Change the dashed line, fixing #280 by @amanusk in https://github.com/amanusk/s-tui/pull/282
* Replace built-in stresser's numpy kernel with dense matmul for stronger thermal load by @amanusk in https://github.com/amanusk/s-tui/pull/286
* Handle dynamic Energy Performance Preference in Power Profile by @s-stepien in https://github.com/amanusk/s-tui/pull/287
* Narrow EPP choices reactively when a write is rejected (Intel fix) by @amanusk in https://github.com/amanusk/s-tui/pull/288
* Do not show a strategy if it is not available by @amanusk in https://github.com/amanusk/s-tui/pull/291
* Save stress menu options between sessions by @amanusk in https://github.com/amanusk/s-tui/pull/292
* Feat/amd throttle detect by @amanusk in https://github.com/amanusk/s-tui/pull/281
* Fall back to /proc/device-tree/model for processor name by @Sanjays2402 in https://github.com/amanusk/s-tui/pull/295
* Disable buffering on MSR reads by @JosefSchoenberger in https://github.com/amanusk/s-tui/pull/297
* fix: handle psutil sensor read failures by @gentosai404 in https://github.com/amanusk/s-tui/pull/299
* Handle non-IndexError failures in graph and summary updates by @Sanjays2402 in https://github.com/amanusk/s-tui/pull/296
* chore(lint): pyright basic mode, drop 21 stale urwid ignores by @amanusk in https://github.com/amanusk/s-tui/pull/301
* fix: stop rebuilding Fan/Rapl widget tree every cycle (100% CPU after hours) by @amanusk in https://github.com/amanusk/s-tui/pull/300

## New Contributors
* @tang-vu made their first contribution in https://github.com/amanusk/s-tui/pull/278
* @s-stepien made their first contribution in https://github.com/amanusk/s-tui/pull/287
* @Sanjays2402 made their first contribution in https://github.com/amanusk/s-tui/pull/295
* @JosefSchoenberger made their first contribution in https://github.com/amanusk/s-tui/pull/297
* @gentosai404 made their first contribution in https://github.com/amanusk/s-tui/pull/299

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/amanusk/s-tui/compare/v1.4.0...v1.5.0
